package audio

// ddsonic composed-stage D7 (M3b2 plan v9 §2.7): the composed rows' view of
// a key provider's request lifecycle (I5-D, I5-O, L5, I9, I10), and, for the
// rows that need them (M3B2-S4 bundle, A-2), the SDK's own per-provider test
// hooks: each write's stamp, the generation of the connection selected for
// it and what its send returned; I10-OD's disclosed never-firing expiry
// control; and I18's sequence exhaustion, set at the provider's pre-request
// boundary. For the step-5 rows (M3B2-S5, G1) it also offers, by option
// only, the SDK's own afterStamp, betweenL6L7 and passDone points as
// one-shot holds (I26 pre-send, I28, I30), a window the test fires (I28,
// I30, as the SDK contract's S32 and S37 fire theirs), and a read of one
// record and of the announced generation. Like the other composed helpers
// it exists only in the overlay the composed stage builds over a staged
// copy of go-librespot (the active stage only; never in the stock O): no
// shipped SDK byte changes. Nothing here is installed by default: a
// provider nobody hooked keeps p.hooks == nil, as in production.

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// DDSonicComposedKeyState is p's record table size, its writer queue length
// and how many answers it took that found no live request, read together
// under the provider's leaf lock.
func DDSonicComposedKeyState(p *KeyProvider) (records, queue int, unknown uint64) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return len(p.table), len(p.queue), p.unknown
}

// DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt is one write of a key request as the provider's
// own hooks saw it (provider.go :325-337). Stamped: the stamp callback ran,
// with the request's sequence and the generation of the connection selected
// for it, before the write. Returned: SendStamped returned, with Err, and
// APDone tells whether the access point was already Done at that moment. A
// stamp is not a physical write: Err is what the write path returned, and a
// send that returned before selecting a connection has no stamp.
type DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt struct {
	Seq      uint32
	Gen      uint64
	Stamped  bool
	Returned bool
	Err      error
	APDone   bool
}

// DDSonicComposedKeyHooks are the hooks installed on one provider and what
// they saw.
type DDSonicComposedKeyHooks struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	attempts []DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt
	armings  []uint32

	// The step-5 options (G1); each is nil or false unless set.
	p          *KeyProvider
	holds      bool
	onDemand   bool
	windows    map[uint32]*ddsonicComposedWindow
	afterStamp map[uint32]*ddsonicComposedHold
	l6l7, pass *ddsonicComposedHold
}

// ddsonicComposedHold is one armed one-shot hold: the first call of its
// point takes it, closes reached and waits for release; later calls pass.
type ddsonicComposedHold struct {
	reached chan struct{}
	release chan struct{}
	relOnce sync.Once
}

func newDDSonicComposedHold() *ddsonicComposedHold {
	return &ddsonicComposedHold{reached: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
}

// Release lets the hold's call through, once and for all; it is idempotent
// and takes no lock (T1).
func (x *ddsonicComposedHold) Release() { x.relOnce.Do(func() { close(x.release) }) }

// wait is the taken hold's one call: it never runs under p.mu or k.mu.
func (x *ddsonicComposedHold) wait() {
	close(x.reached)
	<-x.release
}

// ddsonicComposedWindow is one request's on-demand window.
type ddsonicComposedWindow struct {
	ch   chan time.Time
	once sync.Once
}

// DDSonicComposedKeyOptions selects what DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooksWith
// installs. The zero value installs the write observation only.
type DDSonicComposedKeyOptions struct {
	// NeverExpire is I10-OD's disclosed control: a committed request's
	// window never fires, in place of the SDK's 15 s keyWindow.
	NeverExpire bool
	// ExpireOnDemand (I28, I30) makes each committed request's window a
	// channel that only Expire fires, in place of the SDK's 15 s keyWindow:
	// a disclosed control of I10-OD's class, as S32 and S37 fire theirs.
	ExpireOnDemand bool
	// Holds (I26 pre-send, I28, I30) installs the SDK's afterStamp,
	// betweenL6L7 and passDone points as holds that pass until armed.
	Holds bool
}

// take removes and returns the armed hold *x, if any, under k.mu.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) take(x **ddsonicComposedHold) *ddsonicComposedHold {
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	h := *x
	*x = nil
	return h
}

// arm arms *x with a new hold; one at a time, and only with Holds.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) arm(x **ddsonicComposedHold, what string) (reached <-chan struct{}, release func(), err error) {
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	if !k.holds {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: " + what + ": the key hooks were installed without Holds")
	}
	if *x != nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: " + what + " is already armed")
	}
	h := newDDSonicComposedHold()
	*x = h
	return h.reached, h.Release, nil
}

// ArmAfterStamp holds the write of sequence seq at the SDK's afterStamp
// point: after L3.5 stamped the record with its selected connection's
// generation, before the write is attempted (provider.go :322-330), outside
// p.mu. One-shot: the first call for seq waits for release.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) ArmAfterStamp(seq uint32) (reached <-chan struct{}, release func(), err error) {
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	if !k.holds {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: afterStamp: the key hooks were installed without Holds")
	}
	if k.afterStamp[seq] != nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: afterStamp is already armed for this sequence")
	}
	h := newDDSonicComposedHold()
	k.afterStamp[seq] = h
	return h.reached, h.Release, nil
}

// ArmBetweenL6L7 holds the receiver's next pass at the SDK's betweenL6L7
// point: after its L6 section against its snapshot, before L7, with p.mu
// released (provider.go :528-542). One-shot.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) ArmBetweenL6L7() (reached <-chan struct{}, release func(), err error) {
	return k.arm(&k.l6l7, "betweenL6L7")
}

// ArmPassDone holds the receiver's next pass at the SDK's passDone point:
// after its step 2 (L6 and L7) completed, with p.mu released (provider.go
// :447-450). One-shot.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) ArmPassDone() (reached <-chan struct{}, release func(), err error) {
	return k.arm(&k.pass, "passDone")
}

// window is seq's on-demand window, made on first use; k.mu is held.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) window(seq uint32) *ddsonicComposedWindow {
	w := k.windows[seq]
	if w == nil {
		w = &ddsonicComposedWindow{ch: make(chan time.Time)}
		k.windows[seq] = w
	}
	return w
}

// Expire fires sequence seq's on-demand window (ExpireOnDemand only): its
// Request takes the SDK's own expiry branch (provider.go :232-241). It is
// idempotent; a window fired before its request armed it fires at arming.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) Expire(seq uint32) error {
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	if !k.onDemand {
		return errors.New("ddsonic composed: Expire: the key hooks were installed without ExpireOnDemand")
	}
	w := k.window(seq)
	w.once.Do(func() { close(w.ch) })
	return nil
}

// DDSonicComposedKeyRecord is one live record as the provider holds it,
// read under p.mu. Live false: the record is not (or no longer) in the
// table; a terminal record leaves it (L2, provider.go :276-291).
type DDSonicComposedKeyRecord struct {
	Live     bool
	State    string // admitted, committed, writing, sent
	Stamp    uint64
	Expiring bool
}

// Record reads sequence seq's record under the provider's leaf lock. It is
// never called from a hook.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) Record(seq uint32) DDSonicComposedKeyRecord {
	p := k.p
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	r, ok := p.table[seq]
	if !ok {
		return DDSonicComposedKeyRecord{}
	}
	state := "terminal"
	switch r.state {
	case keyAdmitted:
		state = "admitted"
	case keyCommitted:
		state = "committed"
	case keyWriting:
		state = "writing"
	case keySent:
		state = "sent"
	}
	return DDSonicComposedKeyRecord{Live: true, State: state, Stamp: r.stamp, Expiring: r.expiring}
}

// KickReceiver makes the provider's receiver run one more pass, with the
// SDK's own non-blocking kick on its kickR channel (provider.go :165-170),
// as S32 and S37 do: a pass that would happen at the next kick anyway,
// brought forward so that an armed hold is reached before the test induces
// anything. It changes no record and no classification.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) KickReceiver() { kick(k.p.kickR) }

// Pending is the highest generation the access point has announced to the
// provider (provider.go :155-163), read under its leaf lock.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) Pending() uint64 {
	k.p.mu.Lock()
	defer k.p.mu.Unlock()
	return k.p.pendingGen
}

// Attempts is a copy of the writes seen so far, in order.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) Attempts() []DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt {
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt(nil), k.attempts...)
}

// Armings are the sequences whose window the never-firing expiry control
// replaced (I10-OD), in order.
func (k *DDSonicComposedKeyHooks) Armings() []uint32 {
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]uint32(nil), k.armings...)
}

// DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooks installs the SDK's keyHooks on p: the write
// observation and, when neverExpire is set, I10-OD's disclosed control, a
// committed request's window that never fires in place of the SDK's 15 s
// keyWindow (provider.go :213-219), each arming recorded. Production has no
// hooks; the SDK requires a test to set them before the provider's first
// request (provider.go :114-117), so a provider that already has hooks, or
// has admitted a request, is refused. The hooks take only their own lock and
// never wait.
func DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooks(p *KeyProvider, neverExpire bool) (*DDSonicComposedKeyHooks, error) {
	return DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooksWith(p, DDSonicComposedKeyOptions{NeverExpire: neverExpire})
}

// DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooksWith is DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooks with
// the step-5 options (G1). With only NeverExpire it installs exactly what
// DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooks always did: afterStamp, betweenL6L7 and
// passDone stay nil. Holds adds those three points, each passing until
// armed; ExpireOnDemand replaces the window by one Expire fires. An armed
// hold waits outside p.mu and k.mu, and only in its own call; nothing else
// here waits. NeverExpire and ExpireOnDemand exclude each other.
func DDSonicComposedInstallKeyHooksWith(p *KeyProvider, o DDSonicComposedKeyOptions) (*DDSonicComposedKeyHooks, error) {
	if o.NeverExpire && o.ExpireOnDemand {
		return nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: NeverExpire and ExpireOnDemand exclude each other")
	}
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	if p.hooks != nil || p.next != 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: key hooks must be installed before the provider's first request")
	}
	k := &DDSonicComposedKeyHooks{
		p:          p,
		holds:      o.Holds,
		onDemand:   o.ExpireOnDemand,
		windows:    map[uint32]*ddsonicComposedWindow{},
		afterStamp: map[uint32]*ddsonicComposedHold{},
	}
	hooks := &keyHooks{
		beforeStamp: func(seq uint32, gen uint64) {
			k.mu.Lock()
			k.attempts = append(k.attempts, DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt{Seq: seq, Gen: gen, Stamped: true})
			k.mu.Unlock()
		},
		afterSend: func(seq uint32, err error) {
			done := false
			select {
			case <-p.ap.Done():
				done = true
			default:
			}
			k.mu.Lock()
			defer k.mu.Unlock()
			for i := len(k.attempts) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
				if a := &k.attempts[i]; a.Seq == seq && a.Stamped && !a.Returned {
					a.Returned, a.Err, a.APDone = true, err, done
					return
				}
			}
			k.attempts = append(k.attempts, DDSonicComposedKeyAttempt{Seq: seq, Returned: true, Err: err, APDone: done})
		},
	}
	if o.NeverExpire {
		never := make(chan time.Time)
		hooks.expiry = func(seq uint32) <-chan time.Time {
			k.mu.Lock()
			k.armings = append(k.armings, seq)
			k.mu.Unlock()
			return never
		}
	}
	if o.ExpireOnDemand {
		hooks.expiry = func(seq uint32) <-chan time.Time {
			k.mu.Lock()
			defer k.mu.Unlock()
			k.armings = append(k.armings, seq)
			return k.window(seq).ch
		}
	}
	if o.Holds {
		hooks.afterStamp = func(seq uint32) {
			k.mu.Lock()
			h := k.afterStamp[seq]
			delete(k.afterStamp, seq)
			k.mu.Unlock()
			if h != nil {
				h.wait()
			}
		}
		hooks.betweenL6L7 = func() {
			if h := k.take(&k.l6l7); h != nil {
				h.wait()
			}
		}
		hooks.passDone = func() {
			if h := k.take(&k.pass); h != nil {
				h.wait()
			}
		}
	}
	p.hooks = hooks
	return k, nil
}

// DDSonicComposedExhaust sets p's sequence allocator to its end, at the
// provider's pre-request boundary and under its own lock, so that its next
// real admission returns the SDK's own ErrKeySequenceExhausted (provider.go
// :255-260). The allocator's check is unchanged; a provider that has
// admitted a request is refused.
func DDSonicComposedExhaust(p *KeyProvider) error {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	if p.next != 0 || len(p.table) != 0 {
		return errors.New("ddsonic composed: the provider has already admitted a request")
	}
	p.next = 1 << 32
	return nil
}
